milestones.title: Month 1 — scope and reproducibility
milestones.description: 40h work + 10h reserve; freeze rights, contracts, holdouts, and environment.

milestones.title: Month 4 — baseline evidence
milestones.description: 160h work + 40h reserve; runnable data and baseline pipeline with leakage controls.

milestones.title: Month 7 — first functional public release
milestones.description: 160h work + 40h reserve; cumulative 360h work + 90h reserve; usable replay, evaluation, exports and install instructions.

milestones.title: Month 10 — robustness and deployment
milestones.description: 160h work + 40h reserve; hardening, integration, workflow validation and operational packaging.

milestones.title: By month 12 — maintained handoff
milestones.description: 120h work + 30h reserve; security, release, maintenance rehearsal and final scope decision; 800h total.

issues.title: Freeze triage scope and evidence tiers
issues.body: Output: docs/scope.md and docs/evidence-tiers.md. Steps: define four damage classes, located versus unlocated workflows and simulated-map boundaries. Acceptance: technical finish excludes field capture and every claim has an evidence category. Test: walk image-only, synthetic-route and unavailable-real-data scenarios. Dependencies: none; use the approved proposal and implementation protocol. Record commands, pinned inputs, observed results and remaining limitations in the output evidence. Keep all data provenance attached and do not introduce manual annotation. Stop at the stated deliverable; any scope or interface change requires the protocol's design review.

issues.title: Resolve data rights and fallback
issues.body: Output: data/licenses/manifest.json and docs/rights-decision.md. Steps: record conflicting RDD notices, weight licenses and optional mapping terms; select owned rendering fallback. Acceptance: unresolved rights block data adoption while the synthetic path remains executable. Test: specify rejection of unknown-license assets and missing attribution. Dependencies: RC-001. Record commands, pinned inputs, observed results and remaining limitations in the output evidence. Keep all data provenance attached and do not introduce manual annotation. Stop at the stated deliverable; any scope or interface change requires the protocol's design review.

issues.title: Freeze observation contracts and splits
issues.body: Output: schemas/observation.json, schemas/detection.json and evaluation/splits.json. Steps: define coordinate provenance, nullable locations, grouped holdouts and export semantics. Acceptance: camera positions cannot masquerade as defect positions and split groups are immutable. Test: test axis order, absent GPS and duplicate-cluster separation. Dependencies: RC-001, RC-002. Record commands, pinned inputs, observed results and remaining limitations in the output evidence. Keep all data provenance attached and do not introduce manual annotation. Stop at the stated deliverable; any scope or interface change requires the protocol's design review.

issues.title: Define CPU environment and fixture limits

Acceptance: bootstrap uses no paid service and includes an offline synthetic route fixture. Test: specify dependency imports, coordinate conversion and local viewer smoke checks. Dependencies: RC-003. Record commands, pinned inputs, observed results and remaining limitations in the output evidence. Keep all data provenance attached and do not introduce manual annotation. Stop at the stated deliverable; any scope or interface change requires the protocol's design review.

issues.title: Generate roads with automatic labels
issues.body: Output: src/generation/ and fixtures/synthetic-roads/. Before implementation, split this epic into four 10h children, redistributing its 40h estimate: road geometry; four defect primitives; camera trajectories; label and provenance exports. Acceptance: boxes and synthetic coordinates derive from renderer truth with explicit source flags. Test: test visible-box boundaries and deterministic seeds across held-out scene families. Dependencies: RC-002, RC-003, RC-004. Complete children in the listed order; each must include its relevant test and evidence in the output directory. Record versions, commands, inputs and limitations. Do not count child estimates again or spend reserve without a milestone decision.

Dependencies: RC-002, RC-003, RC-005. Complete children in the listed order; each must include its relevant test and evidence in the output directory.
